subject: Copywriting
title: When Mail Was King
description: A short lesson to help you apply When Mail Was King.

hook.text: In the 1950s, Americans received 50 billion pieces of mail per year.

buildup.text: Before the internet, direct mail was the highest-ROI marketing channel. One stamp, one letter, one sale.

discovery.text: Direct mail copywriters were the rockstars of advertising. Gary Halbert, Joe Sugarman, and Gene Schwartz became legends.

twist.text: The format is dead—but the principles live on. Every landing page, email, and sales funnel is a digital sales letter.

climax.text: Understanding the golden age of sales letters means understanding the DNA of every piece of persuasive writing since.

punchline.text: 50 billion letters a year. The golden age trained every modern copywriter.

quiz.question: Why are sales letter principles still relevant today?
options: Every landing page and email is a digital sales letter
